question:
In the following triad, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

WEAR - EAWR - RAEW

SINK - INSK - KNIS
solution:

For, WEAR → EAWR → RAEW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fd4163b63dafc0a96d092a951cc1c3fcc388355c3bfbfef3c1e7e5a59242cb0.png]

Option 1) BITE → BTIE → ETIB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97547d290d9a4aa58c23b4d2c88b5de4ef7af54b63756e2f6042ce123bbc2a30.png]
